title.narrative: ESARO continued to support countries to fully embrace the shift towards multi-systems programming to prevent all forms of malnutrition, as well as continuing to support countries to scale up early detection and treatment of wasting and prepare and respond to emergencies. First Foods Africa scoping was supported in 15 countries and a country process for nutrition and climate action was tested.
